evals.query: Write an integration test for the checkout flow -- user adds an item, goes to checkout, and confirms payment

files.content:
name: fake_app
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  integration_test:
    sdk: flutter
dev_dependencies:
  mocktail: ^1.0.0

expected_behavior: Reads reference/integration-testing.md before generating the test
Recognizes checkout/payment as a critical, revenue-impacting flow that genuinely warrants the integration_test layer rather than defaulting to a cheaper widget test
Uses IntegrationTestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized() and drives the real app entrypoint, per the integration_test pattern

Does not add the Patrol dependency unless the flow needs a native-OS-level interaction (permission dialog, biometric prompt, native payment sheet) that plain integration_test cannot reach -- and explains that reasoning if it comes up
Notes that this is the most expensive test layer and keeps the test scoped to the one critical flow rather than expanding into a large integration suite unasked
